description: Close the toaster oven door. | The door reached near upright with valid tracking, then the final inward segments failed the unchanged rotation-progress check. Fresh821 paired rim and roof depths remain reliable, and current wrist orientation fits the inspected exterior-contact candidate. Execute its complete bounded release, upper clearance, exterior withdrawal, closed-finger alignment and seating procedure, adapted to left-camera tracking and the retained local arc reference. Original clearance, tracking, reopening, blocked-motion and object-progress limits remain intact. This changes engagement rather than repeating the stopped push; code retains the entire task and static checks are not success.
parameter_sources: Fresh step821 left camera near rim [168,113,174,114] and second rim [149,115,155,116] measure z0.524817 and0.524728m; roof [157,99,165,102] measures z0.528443m. Runtime remeasures these regions and tracks independently. Current measured OSC local-z downward dot is about0.960; retain the original0.92 orientation prerequisite.

arc_reference uses the existing episode local pivot [0.4217820883002722,-0.035730195592064,0.25390547037659367] referenced at741, and same-step left roof [0.5492986292432797,-0.05587386812514841,0.5285500701376098], with prior measured inward. The original visible lower-lip selection is now occluded by the raised door and is not reused as fixed geometry. Current roof shift, paired edge direction, current marker radii and near-upright angle validate the retained local model; no physical hinge or contact is asserted.
